title: Fairness in Online Social Network Timelines: Measurements, Models and Mechanism Design
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It focuses on measuring political bias and the fairness of content filtering on Facebook News Feeds during the 2018 Italian elections.
findings: The paper contains no findings related to religion, as its focus is on political bias in social media algorithms.
